defmodule FirmwareCache do
  @moduledoc """
  IoT device firmware feature flag cache with ETS-backed storage.
  Supports remote configuration updates via signed payloads.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @cache_table :firmware_feature_flags
  @stale_threshold_ms 30_000
  @hmac_algo :sha256

  defstruct [:device_id, :secret_key, :last_sync, :generation]

  # Client API

  def start_link(opts) do
    device_id = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :device_id)
    secret_key = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :secret_key)
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{device_id: device_id, secret_key: secret_key}, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def get_flag(flag_name) do
    case :ets.lookup(@cache_table, flag_name) do
      [{^flag_name, value, gen, ts}] ->
        if cache_fresh?(ts), do: {:ok, value}, else: {:stale, value}
      [] ->
        {:error, :not_found}
    end
  end

  def apply_update(payload, signature) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:apply_update, payload, signature})
  end

  def get_generation do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :get_generation)
  end

  # Server callbacks

  @impl true
  def init(%{device_id: device_id, secret_key: secret_key}) do
    :ets.new(@cache_table, [:named_table, :set, :public, read_concurrency: true])
    state = %__MODULE__{
      device_id: device_id,
      secret_key: secret_key,
      last_sync: nil,
      generation: 0
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:apply_update, payload, signature}, _from, state) do
    case process_update(payload, signature, state) do
      {:ok, new_state} ->
        {:reply, :ok, new_state}
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.warning("Update rejected: #{reason}")
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_generation, _from, state) do
    {:reply, state.generation, state}
  end

  # Internal functions

  defp process_update(payload, signature, state) do
    with {:ok, decoded} <- decode_payload(payload),
         :ok <- verify_signature(payload, signature, state),
         :ok <- validate_generation(decoded, state) do
      apply_flags(decoded["flags"], state)
    end
  end

  defp decode_payload(payload) when is_binary(payload) do
    case Jason.decode(payload) do
      {:ok, %{"device_id" => _, "generation" => _, "flags" => _} = decoded} ->
        {:ok, decoded}
      {:ok, _} ->
        {:error, :invalid_payload_structure}
      {:error, _} ->
        {:error, :json_decode_failed}
    end
  end

  defp verify_signature(payload, signature, state) do
    expected = compute_hmac(payload, state.secret_key)
    if secure_compare(expected, signature) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_signature}
    end
  end

  defp validate_generation(%{"generation" => incoming_gen}, %{generation: current_gen}) do
    if incoming_gen >= current_gen do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :stale_generation}
    end
  end

  defp apply_flags(flags, state) when is_map(flags) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    new_gen = state.generation + 1

    Enum.each(flags, fn {key, value} ->
      normalized_key = normalize_flag_key(key)
      :ets.insert(@cache_table, {normalized_key, value, new_gen, now})
    end)

    {:ok, %{state | generation: new_gen, last_sync: now}}
  end

  defp normalize_flag_key(key) when is_binary(key) do
    key
    |> String.downcase()
    |> String.trim()
  end

  defp compute_hmac(data, key) do
    :crypto.mac(:hmac, @hmac_algo, key, data)
    |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  end

  defp secure_compare(a, b) when is_binary(a) and is_binary(b) do
    if byte_size(a) == byte_size(b) do
      secure_compare_bytes(a, b, 0)
    else
      false
    end
  end

  defp secure_compare_bytes(<<>>, <<>>, acc), do: acc == 0
  defp secure_compare_bytes(<<x, rest_a::binary>>, <<y, rest_b::binary>>, acc) do
    import Bitwise
    secure_compare_bytes(rest_a, rest_b, acc ||| (x ^^^ y))
  end

  defp cache_fresh?(timestamp) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    now - timestamp < @stale_threshold_ms
  end
end

defmodule FirmwareCache.Updater do
  @moduledoc """
  Handles periodic sync and processes queued updates.
  Uses generation-based conflict resolution.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @sync_interval_ms 60_000

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(_opts) do
    schedule_sync()
    {:ok, %{pending_updates: :queue.new(), processed_generations: MapSet.new()}}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info(:sync, state) do
    state = process_pending(state)
    schedule_sync()
    {:noreply, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:enqueue_update, payload, sig}, state) do
    new_queue = :queue.in({payload, sig}, state.pending_updates)
    {:noreply, %{state | pending_updates: new_queue}}
  end

  defp process_pending(state) do
    case :queue.out(state.pending_updates) do
      {{:value, {payload, sig}}, rest} ->
        case FirmwareCache.apply_update(payload, sig) do
          :ok ->
            gen = FirmwareCache.get_generation()
            new_processed = MapSet.put(state.processed_generations, gen)
            process_pending(%{state | pending_updates: rest, processed_generations: new_processed})
          {:error, _reason} ->
            process_pending(%{state | pending_updates: rest})
        end
      {:empty, _} ->
        state
    end
  end

  defp schedule_sync do
    Process.send_after(self(), :sync, @sync_interval_ms)
  end
end
